text: Diagnosia convention: a handoff carries references only, and the receiving tool re-reads the source record.
Diagnosia convention: no tool produces a handoff today, so an agent must not assume one.
Diagnosia convention: AI output needs a person's review. Generated doesn't mean approved.
Diagnosia convention: unreadable or unsure content goes to a person and is never guessed.
Diagnosia convention: the Diagnosia database is the record, and shared context is supplemental.
